## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Benchmark or result artifact

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for every behavior change
- [ ] No model weights, checkpoints, `.env` files, or private prompts included
- [ ] Frozen beam-16 defaults unchanged, or the change is justified with
      results measured on new development data
- [ ] Any new measured number is reported with model, hardware, length,
      precision, prompt distribution, and timing boundary
